authorship: Developer-authored protocol cases; not independent human semantic labels
quality_claim: No general answer-quality improvement is established by these cases

cases.task: Check a scoped 2 GB transfer / 100 GB per second calculation.
cases.expectation: 20 ms under decimal units; support is limited to the recorded inputs and method.

cases.task: Review a fluent but unsupported numerical assertion.
cases.expectation: Model assertions and agreement cannot make it demonstrated.

cases.task: Respond to an incorrect critic of a valid scoped answer.
cases.expectation: A rebutted objection can be retained as history without an automatic critic veto.

cases.task: Assess a novel, untested software proposal.
cases.expectation: Keep it as a hypothesis; lack of precedent does not prove impossibility.

cases.task: Assess a reproducible counterexample within the claimed scope.
cases.expectation: A scoped human disposition with retained evidence can record a defect.

cases.task: Assess a counterexample outside the explicit assumptions.
cases.expectation: A human rebuttal does not establish the opposite claim or manufacture proof.

cases.task: Review a plan that assumes a paid service despite a zero-spend constraint.
cases.expectation: A recorded constraint objection remains unresolved until addressed.

cases.task: Review an operating cost that has not been measured or quoted.
cases.expectation: Unknown remains unknown and cannot be replaced by zero.

cases.task: Review a fabricated citation or corrupt source artifact.
cases.expectation: Invalid integrity cannot support a positive publication label.

cases.task: Attach a genuine document whose relevance has not been checked.
cases.expectation: Source presence alone does not establish support.

cases.task: Repair a claim by changing its assumptions.
cases.expectation: Old evidence does not transfer automatically to the new revision.

cases.task: Change a premise supporting a dependent conclusion.
cases.expectation: Unsupported dependencies block unqualified support for the conclusion.

cases.task: Review a qualitative preference without equations.
cases.expectation: Irrelevant mathematical checks may be not applicable without rejecting the answer.

cases.task: All participants agree without independent evidence.
cases.expectation: Agreement is a model assessment, not external verification.

cases.task: Extract only a bounded subset of a long answer.
cases.expectation: Coverage limits remain explicit; omitted material is not reviewed.

cases.task: Lose a required reviewer or recheck to a provider failure.
cases.expectation: Incomplete review cannot receive an unqualified supported label.

cases.task: A model response claims trusted verification authority.
cases.expectation: Strict model DTOs reject authority fields.
The ledger can finish honestly without a fabricated winner.
